role: Development study of retaining learned operation parameters while adapting to changed observations in the same world. Fixed model size and dynamics; separate mapping initialization from operation reuse. No continual-learning, foundation, novelty or general speed claim.

data.scope: Fresh signed-permutation/flip world. All fitting initial and prefix states are in the training state partition. Validation/development paths may also visit training states but cannot enter another held-out state partition. Complement-paired sampling balances canonical bits. Neither runtime nor fitting sees canonical state, inverse observation map or action rules.

model.architecture: Unchanged four generic additive coupling layers and four affine operation maps; inverse decoder.

arms.frozen_warm: Initialize mapping and operations from the registered own-parent snapshot. Train mappings; freeze all operation coefficients.
arms.frozen_reset: Own-initialize the mapping with the adaptation seed. Copy and freeze the registered own-parent operation coefficients.
arms.refit_warm: Initialize mapping from the same own-parent snapshot and refit affine maps on current new-view observations.
arms.refit_reset: Own-initialize the mapping and refit affine maps on current new-view observations; task-specific from-scratch comparator.

model.old_version: Keep the original complete parent snapshot immutable and present for every arm. New versions each contain 1780 coefficients; no physical deduplication or zero-storage reuse is claimed.

training.curriculum: Each arm/view/seed begins its own one-step adaptation. No view is a prerequisite for another. All three seeds must acquire and replay before that arm/view enters mixed fitting. Mixed starts from its own earliest passing one-step snapshot with fresh Adam.
training.sampling: Same seeded batches for every arm and view: seed offset +1 for one, +2 for mixed. All one-step fits complete before any mixed fit.
training.prediction_loss: Mean squared observed-coordinate error over every free-running prefix, averaged within and across trajectories.
training.auxiliary: Reconstruction is numerically near zero by reversibility. Refit arms additionally encode the same permitted full one-step observation pool. No paired-view or parent-encoder target is supplied.
training.optimization: Adam updates only the 1340 coupling parameters in all arms. Frozen arms preserve the 440 parent operation values exactly after every update. Refit arms use the unchanged detached float64 solver at step zero and every 32 updates. No implicit derivative or added latent objective.

acquisition.selection: Earliest checkpoint passing every gate; if none passes, retain minimum validation prediction MSE, with earliest step breaking ties. Complete and charge the full fitting duration. Selected development evaluation therefore refers to the observed first acquired snapshot.
acquisition.mixed_admission: All 24 one-step fits must complete first. Each arm/view may advance only when all three seeds acquire at the single registered rate and each selected parent fully replays.

evaluation.scope: First replay all three old-parent baseline checks. After every mixed seed in an arm/view acquires and replays, evaluate its selected snapshots on new-view development compositions and continuations. No final entry point.
evaluation.baseline: Three runs, one per retained parent. Re-evaluate old nonlinear development and continuation with controls, and measure zero-shot training/validation one-step prediction on both new views. No new-view development predictions at this stage.
evaluation.families: The existing 608-case development set, all intermediate prefixes, and 64 common-state continuation pairs. Own predicted states only. Preserve zero-initial, reversed-order and zero-state controls; label true-current-observation resets explicitly.
evaluation.selection_unit: All three adaptation seeds within each of four arms and two views. Each view has an independent task-specific gate. Only own predicted state supports the primary result.
evaluation.comparison: Factorial contrasts: frozen_warm versus refit_warm and frozen_reset versus refit_reset isolate retaining operation values at the same mapping initialization; warm versus reset within each operation treatment measures initialization reuse. Information access, batches, architecture and update ceilings are common; refit has extra full-pool encodings and solves.
evaluation.retention: Old snapshots remain byte-identical and their registered old-world competence is replayed before fitting. Every new run embeds its needed old snapshot. This is retained-version competence, not evidence of avoiding interference in shared changing parameters.
evaluation.decision: Report candidate competence, operation identity and initialization effects per view and seed. A scoped operation-reuse result requires every seed in that frozen arm/view to pass one, mixed and development gates with unchanged operations. Overall bridge competence across both views requires both to pass; translation alone is a limited result.
evaluation.cost_decision: Compare actual total spent work including full fits, failure, inherited acquisition, baselines and verification. Separately report the work recorded at earliest passing checkpoints. If a frozen arm and refit_reset both achieve development competence, a descriptive acquisition-point benefit requires at least 25 percent fewer selected cumulative one+mixed gradient updates in every paired seed, no greater charged model multiplies/adds/tanh or observed-example exposures at those points, and no larger model. This does not imply actual campaign savings or controlled wall-time speedup; otherwise no such benefit is claimed.
evaluation.follow_on: Close this two-view bridge study before selecting another task. Dynamics changes, partial observation, compression and provider integration require separate decisions.

verification: Committed source and transform/protocol registration; actual float32 input/partition audit; synthetic translation capacity check; independent scalar parity; per-update operation freezing; earliest-acquisition selection; embedded parent and dependency identity; failure injection; all checkpoint/refit/baseline/development replay; private archive and eight restored-source replays. Inference snapshots only, not exact optimizer resume.
stop_condition: Close after the fixed four-arm, two-view, three-seed comparison, admitted mixed fits and development evaluations. No replacement seeds, additional rates, wider model, new objective, final access, dynamics change or solver fallback.

solver.fit: For each action, encode initial and observed next vectors with the current learned encoder in float32, convert to float64, append a bias column, and solve X B approximately Y. Require rank 11, finite solution and condition <=1e8. Copy B[:10].T and B[10] to float32 transition tensors only after all four solves pass.
solver.support: Use the fixed 512 permitted one-step training pairs in both one and mixed stages. Never fit on a validation prefix, predicted target, canonical state, generator rule or evaluation observation.
solver.failure: Abort and retain the attempted fit on insufficient support, deficient rank, excess condition, nonfinite values or a normalized normal-equation residual above 1e-10. No ridge, fallback driver, random retry or replacement seed.
solver.replay: Save each post-refit full model snapshot and per-action rank/singular values/residual report. Replay every solve from that snapshot's encoder and the regenerated permitted training pairs; compare fitted maps and diagnostics. Verify scheduled refit coverage and unchanged coupling tensors during each solve.
solver.cost: Charge each pair in affine_fit_examples, both encoder passes in auxiliary_observations/model arithmetic, each action system in linear_systems, and all 440 assigned coefficients in fitted_parameter_assignments. Record matrix shapes and solver time separately; SVD arithmetic is not claimed as complete FLOPs.

observation_change.definition: shift: u=y+b. remix: u=Q y+b. Q is the product of two dense Householder reflections from fixed-seed uniform vectors, independent of action rules, states, coupling masks and quality results. Both act on the existing nonlinear observations; Q is orthogonal with determinant +1.
observation_change.learner_access: Only transformed initial vectors, action indices and observed transformed training consequences. No old/new observation pairs, transform matrix, offset, inverse, canonical state, view label or old-model target enters a training tensor. The experimenter selects the version at an explicit regime boundary.
observation_change.audit: Audit actual float32 ordered inputs and prefix actions, transformed state injectivity and partition boundaries before fitting. Preflight may render non-final observations for structural audit, but no candidate development-quality evaluation is admitted until all-seed acquisition.
observation_change.capacity: Translation closure of the fixed four-coupling family is verified on synthetic parameters by a generic algebraic bias reparameterization in tests only. This transformation is never a learned-arm initialization. No capacity claim is made for arbitrary dense remixes.

accounting.inherited: Charge the entire retained EXP-0009 campaign (310.5201854609186 recorded seconds, 55336 gradient updates, 72114176 charged bytes) once as shared upstream acquisition, alongside each selected parent lineage. Its development search is not free. Do not charge it twice across repeated arm comparisons.
accounting.rendering: Record new-view observation vectors and affine transform multiply/add counts in benchmark generation, separate from learner arithmetic. Learned encode/decode conversion is already included in model forward counts. Matrix construction, file I/O and checks remain in elapsed time, not claimed complete FLOPs.
accounting.storage: Retain every 1780-parameter new snapshot and every embedded original 1780-parameter snapshot; report actual bytes and both versions rather than claiming free shared storage.
accounting.full_duration: Learning always completes registered update ceilings, even after an early passing point. Acquisition-point telemetry is prospective stopping evidence and distinct from actual campaign consumption.
